items.name: ui
items.title: Chelone UI Primitives
items.description: The shadcn/ui primitive layer Chelone components compose (button, card, dialog, field, sidebar, table, …), shipped verbatim so consumers can install a single primitive or the whole set.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: admin
items.title: Chelone Admin
items.description: The Chelone admin component surface (Admin, List, Edit, DataTable, TextField, TextInput, the auth pages, layout, buttons, fields, inputs, and views) wired onto the @chelone/vue composables. Granularizes so each component installs on its own.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: monaco
items.title: Chelone Monaco
items.docs: Monaco runs its editor and JSON workers on the main thread unless the app sets MonacoEnvironment.getWorker. With Vite, import the workers with ?worker (editor.worker and json.worker from monaco-editor/esm/vs/...) and assign getWorker on self before the first render. Without it Monaco logs a console warning and still works.
items.description: The opt-in Monaco add-on: MonacoJsonField shows a JSON value in a read-only Monaco editor. Monaco loads in its own chunk, so nothing reaches the base bundle until the field renders. Installs monaco-editor and @guolao/vue-monaco-editor.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: charts
items.title: Chelone Charts
items.description: The opt-in charts add-on: TrendChart draws a line or an area, BarChart a bar per row and DonutChart a segment per value, each in a card, with unovis. Installs @unovis/vue and @unovis/ts.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: kanban
items.title: Chelone Kanban
items.description: The opt-in kanban add-on: KanbanBoard shows the records of a list as columns and moves a card between them by drag with mouse, touch or pen, or with a Move to menu. Installs @dnd-kit/vue and needs Vue 3.5.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: inspector
items.title: Chelone Inspector
items.description: The opt-in inspector add-on: Inspector is a draggable panel that edits whichever Configurable the user picks, InspectorButton turns the mode on, and SortableFieldsSelector lists a table's columns with drag to reorder. Installs @dnd-kit/vue and needs Vue 3.5.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: mdx-editor
items.title: Chelone Markdown
items.description: The opt-in Markdown add-on: MdxField shows a markdown value in a read-only Milkdown Crepe editor and MdxInput edits one, themed from the Chelone tokens. Installs @milkdown/crepe and @milkdown/kit.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: rich-text-input
items.title: Chelone Rich Text
items.docs: The field styles its content with rich-text.css, which the component imports itself and which reads the Chelone color tokens.
items.description: The opt-in rich text add-on: RichTextField shows stored HTML sanitized with DOMPurify, or its text with stripTags, and RichTextInput edits an HTML string in a tiptap editor with a formatting toolbar. Installs dompurify and the tiptap packages.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: block-editor
items.title: Chelone Block Editor
items.description: The opt-in block editor add-on: BlockEditorInput edits a document of rich text and app-defined blocks in a tiptap editor with a slash menu, and BlockDocField shows that document read-only. defineBlock declares a block from a Zod schema and its components, and the data blocks chart a resource. Installs the tiptap packages, @unovis/vue and @unovis/ts, and the charts block.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: maps
items.title: Chelone Maps
items.docs: MapCanvas loads the MapLibre stylesheet itself. The library ships no tile server, so mount MapsProvider once near the root with a mapStyle (rasterTileStyle({ tileUrl, attribution }) from @chelone/core, or a MapLibre style URL), or pass mapStyle to each map. Browsers cap live WebGL contexts near 16 per page, so keep long lists of maps short.
items.description: The opt-in maps add-on: MapCanvas and MapMarker wrap MapLibre GL, MapsProvider sets the basemap once, and LatLngField shows a point from two record fields. Installs maplibre-gl.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: maps-draw
items.title: Chelone Maps Draw
items.docs: Everything here needs the maps block: mount MapsProvider once with a mapStyle, or pass mapStyle to each input. Terra Draw reads its modes, snapping and styles once when the input mounts, so change key to rebuild. Terra Draw rotates a selected line or polygon with Control and r.
items.description: The opt-in map drawing add-on: ShapeInput draws and edits a GeoJSON value on a MapCanvas with Terra Draw, with a DrawToolbar for the tools. Installs terra-draw and terra-draw-maplibre-gl-adapter, and the maps block.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: maps-osm
items.title: Chelone Maps OpenStreetMap
items.docs: The library names no geocoding service. Pass a provider to each component, or set geocoder on MapsProvider, for example createNominatimProvider({ endpoint }) from @chelone/core. A public Nominatim server has a usage policy and allows no search per keystroke, so the input searches on Enter or on its button.
items.description: The opt-in maps add-on for pieces that call a network service: GeocodingInput searches an address with a geocoding provider and fills its coordinates, and MapWithSearch puts that search over a map. Installs maplibre-gl, and the maps block.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: addon-csv-import
items.title: Chelone CSV Import
items.description: The opt-in CSV import add-on: CsvImport adds an Import button that opens a four-step sheet (upload, map columns, preview, import) and useCsvImport reads its state. Installs papaparse.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: addon-supabase
items.title: Chelone Supabase
items.description: The opt-in Supabase add-on: SocialAuthButton and one sign-in button per OAuth provider (Apple to WorkOS). Installs @chelone/supabase.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>

items.name: style-chelone
items.title: Chelone
items.description: Chelone's base configuration: the vanilla shadcn New York style with the neutral base color, Lucide icons, and CSS-variable theming. Install first to set sensible components.json defaults, then add Chelone components.
items.author: Chelone <https://chelone.dev>
